newsitem.title: UK: UK worried about Israel shutting Jerusalem offices.
newsitem.headline: UK worried about Israel shutting Jerusalem offices.

text.p: Britain said on Wednesday it was worried by Israel's demand that four Palestinian offices in East Jerusalem be closed down before it could carry out a scheduled withdrawal from the West Bank.
A Foreign Office spokesman said Britain had called on both sides to keep calm and avoid exacerbating an already tense situation.
Israeli police gave the four offices 96 hours to close or face being shut down. The Israeli withdrawal from mainly rural areas was due to have started on Friday.
"Britain has expressed its concern to the Israeli government over its decision to close the Palestinian institutions in East Jerusalem," the Foreign Office spokesman said by telephone.
"We urge both sides to refrain from actions which could inflame what is already a very tense situation," he said.
Israel enraged the Palestinians last month by announcing it planned to build 6,500 homes for Jews on the southern edge of East Jerusalem, captured in the 1967 Middle East War.

The decision was criticised by Washington, the European Union and Arab states. The Palestinians see Arab East Jerusalem as the capital of a future Palestinian state while Israel says the town will always be its undivided capital.
